title: Sample — Al Safa Café Pavilion
description: One number per leaf. The document calls it Area (m²). Open the Value button to switch to ft² or to change what the number means entirely (Volume, Cost, Length, ...). Values on leaves are stored in the base unit (m²) — switching the display unit converts on screen without rewriting anything.

children.label: Café Pavilion
children.description: Top-level zone. Its value line shows the auto-summed total of every space below it that has a number set.

children.label: Indoor Seating
children.description: Leaf with 42.5 m² stored — renders as ~457.47 ft² while ft² is the display unit.

children.label: Storage
children.description: No value set on purpose — its siblings have one, so this one renders a small 'no area set' warning you can click to fill in.

children.label: Outdoor Terrace
children.description: A second zone with nested sub-spaces, to show a two-level sum.

children.label: Dining Terrace
children.description: This node has children, so it never stores its own value — it derives it from its two leaves below.

children.label: Planter Strip
children.description: Leaf, no value — kept empty deliberately since its sibling (Dining Terrace) does end up with a derived value, so this one gets the warning too.

children.label: Back of House
children.description: No values anywhere in this branch — behaves exactly like a process with the value feature unused. No warnings, no Σ line.
